title: Internal Project Coordinator
description:
This role exists to protect one person's time and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll be the right hand to the Operations Head — managing his calendar, capturing what happens in meetings, and making sure every internal and marketing project moves forward without him having to chase it.
 



 This is not just scheduling and note\-taking. You are the person who knows the status of everything, reminds the right people at the right time, and keeps the operation organized while leadership focuses on growth. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility role — you'll see how a 90\-person company runs from the inside.
 



  





*This role is for someone who enjoys:* 



* Holding the full picture of what's happening across a busy leader's world
* Turning conversations into clear, owned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Following up firmly and politely until things actually get done
* Being trusted with confidential, high\-stakes information



  





 If you're someone who's naturally organized, doesn't let things slip, and wants a front\-row seat to how a growing company operates, this role will suit you well.
 



  





**What you'll really be doing** 




  





**1\. Calendar \& Inbox Management** 



* Own and organize the Operations Head's calendar end to end — schedule, reschedule, resolve conflicts, protect focus time
* Coordinate across time zones, primarily India and US
* Manage email triage: flag what needs attention, draft routine replies, keep the inbox under control



  





**2\. Meeting Support** 



* Attend designated internal, marketing, and leadership meetings to capture minutes, decisions, and action items
* Convert discussions into clear, assigned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Distribute notes promptly and make sure owners know what they committed to



  





**3\. Internal \& Marketing Project Coordination** 



* Keep all internal and marketing projects organized and current in the project management system
* Track status, deadlines, and blockers across active work
* Follow up with team members on tasks assigned by the Operations Head — proactively, before things slip
* Surface what's overdue or at risk before it becomes a problem



  





**4\. Follow\-Up \& Accountability** 



* Maintain a live view of every open commitment across the team
* Remind people on pending items and close the loop
* Be the system that ensures "I asked someone to do this" actually gets done



  





**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You hold many threads at once without dropping any of them
* You follow up firmly and politely — you don't let things go quiet
* You can work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* You're discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information
* You communicate clearly and confidently with US\-based leadership and partners



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* 4–5 years minimum as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Project Coordinator — experience within an IT services company is a must



  





**Must Have Skills** 



* Strong written and spoken English — you'll be communicating with a US\-based leadership team and US agency partners
* Highly organized, detail\-obsessed, and able to hold many threads at once
* Comfortable following up firmly and politely until things are done
* Able to work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* Discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information



  





**Tools \& Platforms** 



* Notion — documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base
* Google Calendar \& Gmail — scheduling and inbox management
* Slack — internal communication
* Fathom — meeting transcription and notes



*Experience with project management tools is required. Direct experience with this exact stack is a plus, not a dealbreaker.* 




  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience supporting a founder, COO, or senior operations leader
* Exposure to a digital agency or multi\-company setup
* Familiarity with AI tools for productivity — meeting summarization, task tracking, or inbox management



  





**What this role offers** 



* A high\-trust, high\-visibility seat next to leadership
* Direct exposure to how a 90\-person company runs day\-to\-day
* Ownership over the systems that keep the operation from slipping
* Room to grow into broader operations responsibility over time

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity
* Posted 17 hours ago


 Website
 **Trading Technologies**
 Multi\-asset platform for capital markets
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
**Compensation:**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.


 Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award\-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies’ clients.
   

  

 Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world’s largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology\-enabled businesses.
   

  

 This investment supports Trading Technologies’ continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long\-term growth for customers and partners worldwide.
   

  

*Trading Technologies (TT) is an equal\-opportunity employer. Equal employment has been, and continues to be, a required practice at the Company. Trading Technologies’ practice of equal employment opportunity is to recruit, hire, train, promote, and base all employment decisions on ability rather than race, color, religion, national origin, sex/gender orientation, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, parental status, veteran, or any other protected status. Additionally, TT participates in the E\-Verify Program for US offices.*
 To apply for this job please visit tradingtechnologies.pinpointhq.com

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

****Essential Skills \& Experience****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


****Desirable Skills \& Experience****
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


****Compensation:****
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

title: SENIOR PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
**ABOUT US:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**JOB SUMMARY:**




  





 As a Senior Project Coordinator within our Project Management Office (PMO), you will act as the operational backbone for active satellite manufacturing and mission delivery cycles. Partnering directly with Project Managers and engineering leads, you will drive execution discipline, eliminate cross\-functional bottlenecks, and ensure mission milestones transition seamlessly from CAD models to cleanroom assembly and launch manifests.
 



  





 Your core operational mandate is predictability: maintaining airtight milestone tracking, accelerating internal procurement loops, and ensuring documentation meets rigorous aerospace standards. In this role, your success will be measured by on\-time milestone delivery rates (OTD), schedule variance reduction, and data accuracy across our PMO toolstack.
 



  





  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




  




* **Drive Schedule \& Milestone Integrity:** 
 Partner with Project Managers to maintain comprehensive work\-breakdown structures (WBS), track critical\-path deliverables, and flag schedule variances before they impact integration timelines.
* **Streamline Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Serve as the day\-to\-day liaison between systems engineering, cleanroom manufacturing, quality assurance, procurement, and external launch partners.
* **Lead PMO Governance \& Meeting Cadence:** 
 Own sprint ceremonies, technical review agendas, and cross\-team standups; capture high\-signal minutes of meeting (MoM) and aggressively drive action\-item closure.
* **Maintain Technical Documentation \& Metrics:** 
 Centralize technical baseline documents, flight readiness paperwork, and engineering change requests (ECRs) while building real\-time status dashboards for executive review.
* **Proactive Risk \& Blocker Resolution:** 
 Surface manufacturing delays, component lead\-time anomalies, and integration risks early; run root\-cause follow\-ups to implement mitigation strategies.
* **Coordinate Technical Procurement \& Logistics:** 
 Expedite technical purchase requisitions (PR/PO workflows) for mission\-critical parts and coordinate precision logistics for aerospace\-grade hardware and testing campaigns.



  





  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR ?**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics, or similar) or Business Administration/Operations Management.
* 1–2 years of hands\-on project coordination or PMO experience in a fast\-paced, engineering\- or manufacturing\-driven environment.
* Working proficiency with industry\-standard project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Project, Asana, or ClickUp).
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with a track record of managing multiple competing deadlines without dropping operational details.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, comfortable interfacing with senior engineering specialists and external vendors.



  





  





**NICE\-TO\-HAVES:**




  




* Prior exposure to the Space, Aerospace, Defense, or Precision Hardware Manufacturing sectors.
* Foundational understanding of satellite subsystems, avionics, payload integration, or cleanroom manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with hardware product lifecycle stages (PDR, CDR, TRR, and flight integration).



  





  





**WHY JOIN US ?**




  




* **Front\-Row Seat to the NewSpace Revolution:** 
 Work on physical flight hardware destined for orbit from India’s first commercial satellite mass\-production hub.
* **Accelerated Career Trajectory:** 
 Receive hands\-on mentorship from veteran aerospace program managers, developing deep domain expertise across space mission lifecycles.
* **High\-Impact, Zero\-Red\-Tape Culture:** 
 Experience the speed of a high\-growth tech disruptor paired with the manufacturing infrastructure of an aerospace leader.
* **Collaborative Ecosystem:** 
 Join an ambitious, multidisciplinary team of space enthusiasts, engineers, and builders dedicated to making space accessible globally.
